discription: A pulsating synth sound using a Pulse wave with variable width, modulated by an LFO, and a standard ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, width=0.5, widthRate=4, widthDepth=0.2;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);var pulseWidth = SinOsc.kr(widthRate).range(width - widthDepth, width + widthDepth);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth) * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
